_doc: F02 VESPER stage 1: one still per shot (prompt lock + colour world + negatives).

args.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of the top of the exact perfume bottle from the reference image (heavy rectangular thick clear-glass bottle with bevelled edges and a thick base, warm amber-gold perfume inside, tall faceted smoky dark-amber glass cap with a thin gold collar, the word VESPER engraved in thin wide-spaced serif capitals centred on the front, tiny 'EAU DE PARFUM' below): the faceted smoky-amber cap fills the upper half of the frame, the engraved VESPER letters crisp below it. A single warm sunset beam passes through the cap and throws golden refracted light and tiny rainbow sparkles across the glass. Black-burgundy background with soft bokeh. 100mm macro, f/5.6. Colour world strictly deep oxblood-burgundy, black and warm amber-gold; low warm sunset-beam key light, crisp specular highlights, golden caustics. Hyper-real luxury fragrance advertising photograph, tack sharp, commercial retouching. The bottle shape, cap and engraved VESPER text stay exactly as in the reference. No other text, no extra bottles.
